section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the translation and psychometric evaluation of a Romanian translation of the 4-item Subjective Happiness Scale (SHS). A principal-axis EFA on the total sample (N = 453) supported a single-factor solution (eigenvalue = 2.52; 63.0% variance explained), and internal consistency was high (Cronbach's alpha = .89 for women and .92 for men). No mention of Study 1/Study 2 or multiple sample subsets appears in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: To examine the factor structure of scores on this translation of the scale, we computed a principal-axis EFA with the total sample (N = 453) using a quartimax rotation because of the expectation of a single factor. The results of the EFA indicated that only a single factor should be extracted, with an eigenvalue (-) of 2.52 and explaining 63.0% of the total variance. Cronbach's alpha was .89 for women and .92 for men.
